name: Delicious Snezhnaya Shashliks
desc: Large chunks of grilled meat skewers. Cracking through its crisp exterior delivers a satisfying crunch, followed by a savory burst of juices. As the skewer roasts over the fire, the marinade deepens into a hearty undertone that highlights the meat's fresh sweetness. Your mouth glistens with grease and juice, but the sheer flavor makes table manners the last thing on your mind...

value.text: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
